statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
Diagnosis codes R55 and G45.9 were used
A long-term continuous ECG monitoring study was performed and reported on CPT code 93247
The service is medically necessary to identify intermittent cardiac arrhythmias that may explain the syncope and transient neurological deficits
Continued monitoring is required to establish an arrhythmic cause for the recurrent symptoms and to guide appropriate management
The claim was denied with reason code CO-29
The denial is based on the time limit for filing having expired
